g.text: A finite horizon gives a bound for the original potential
GC.52–GC.53: an exact field, not a sampled evolution.
GC.13–GC.47 retain the nonidentity static heat gauge and the original temporal anchor on every covering piece.
Energy controls curvature. The displayed gauge derivatives supply the additional potential bound.
